def authorize(self, actor: str, required: str) -> str:
        with self.connect() as db:
            row = db.execute("SELECT role FROM accounts WHERE username=?", (actor or "",)).fetchone()
        role = row["role"] if row else ""
        allowed = role == required
        self.bo.record("authorize", "return", {"actor": actor or "", "required": required}, {"role": role, "allowed": allowed})
        if not allowed: raise DomainError(403 if row else 401, "Role does not permit this action")
        return role

def build_application(root, database, observe=True):
    database.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    service = Gallery(database, root / "bo_stategraph/project.json")
    app = create_app(service)
    adapter = None
    if observe:
        try:
            from integrations.bo_adapter import BOAdapter
            from integrations.bo_web import bo_attach
            adapter = BOAdapter(root, database)
            adapter.graph.bo_require_definition(service.machine.definition)
            bo_attach(app, adapter, root)
            service.bo, service.build_id = adapter.port, adapter.build_id
        except Exception as error:
            if adapter is not None: adapter.bo_close()
            adapter = None
            print(f"Observer unavailable; business remains available: {type(error).__name__}: {error}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    return app, service, adapter

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8842)
    parser.add_argument("--core", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--database", default="work/gallery.sqlite")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    app, service, adapter = build_application(root, root / args.database, not args.core)
    server = make_server("127.0.0.1", args.port, app, threaded=True)
    print(f"Gallery URL: http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/", flush=True)
    print(f"Graph URL: http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/graph" if adapter else "Graph URL: unavailable (business-only mode)", flush=True)
    try: server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt: pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()
        if adapter is not None: adapter.bo_close()

invalid_file.snippet:
def upload(self, actor: str, filename: str, data: bytes) -> dict:
        role = self.authorize(actor, "uploader")
        checked = self.inspect_image(data)
        if not checked["valid"]:
            self.bo.record("invalid_file", "reject", {"format": checked["format"]}, {"status": 415, "created": False})
            raise DomainError(415, "Only actual PNG or JPEG images are accepted")
        ident = uuid.uuid4().hex
        context = {"format": checked["format"], "uploader": actor}
        change = self.machine.transition(self.machine.definition["initial"], "submit", context, {"role": role})
        digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        with self.connect() as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            db.execute("INSERT INTO images VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", (ident, actor, filename[:180], checked["format"], checked["width"], checked["height"], digest, data, change["state"], 1, self.build_id))
            message_id = self.notify(db, ident)
            db.execute("INSERT INTO journal(image_id,event,previous,state,revision) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)", (ident, "submit", change["before"], change["state"], 1))
        event_id = self.bo.record("upload", "commit", {"actor": actor, "filename": filename[:180], "byte_count": len(data)}, {"id": ident, "state": change["state"], "revision": 1, "sha256": digest}, ident)
        self.bo.record("message", "commit", {"image_id": ident}, {"recipient": "reviewer", "message_id": message_id}, ident, ((event_id, "flow"),))
        return {"id": ident, "state": change["state"]}
